name: genz-invest
description: GenZ investing concept (Own What You Love + Squads), built on the MERN stack

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
